lines.text: I'm good, too. What do you do every day?
I wake up, I eat breakfast, I go jogging,
I get the bus to work, I read a book on the bus,
I eat lunch. After I finish work, I swim in the sea.
I eat dinner, I have a shower, then I go to sleep.
How about you? What do you do every day?
I wake up, I have a shower, I eat breakfast,
I drive to work. I listen to a podcast.
I eat lunch, after work I go to the park,
I go home and cook dinner. After dinner I play video games.
